Candidate mechanisms are the build.rs-injected OPENSSL_RS_MODULESDIR/OPENSSLDIR/ENGINESDIR path values and LLVM codegen-unit/internal-symbol partitioning, but none was demonstrated. Recorded as an open reproducibility finding rather than explained away.
rebuild_differential.why_it_did_not_block_publish: the crate payload is source and documentation only (0 files under artifacts/ in the package), and the committed artefacts were retained, so publication changes neither the shipped bytes relative to 0.0.40 nor the measured install.
rebuild_differential.docs_impact: docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md makes a byte-for-byte claim about derived atlas files, not about compiled binaries. Its CI invariant 'no unexplained symbol drift' is now literally violated by an internal-symbol count change, so the invariant needs either a narrower definition (dynamic exports) or a follow-up investigation.
